require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'tempfile'
require 'fileutils'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

module MobileAPI
  ROLES = { admin: 3, manager: 2, user: 1 }.freeze
  UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/app/uploads'

  # Secret used to sign auth tokens. Must be provided via environment in production.
  TOKEN_SECRET = ENV.fetch('AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET') do
    raise 'AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET environment variable must be set' unless ENV['RACK_ENV'] == 'test'
    SecureRandom.hex(32)
  end

  class AuthToken
    def self.generate(user_id, role)
      payload = { uid: user_id, role: role, exp: Time.now.to_i + 3600 }
      encoded = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(JSON.generate(payload))
      signature = sign(encoded)
      "#{encoded}.#{signature}"
    end

    def self.verify(token)
      encoded, signature = token.to_s.split('.', 2)
      return nil unless encoded && signature

      expected = sign(encoded)
      return nil unless secure_compare(expected, signature)

      payload = JSON.parse(Base64.urlsafe_decode64(encoded))
      return nil if payload['exp'].nil? || payload['exp'] < Time.now.to_i
      payload
    rescue
      nil
    end

    def self.sign(data)
      Base64.urlsafe_encode64(
        OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', TOKEN_SECRET, data)
      )
    end

    def self.secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      OpenSSL.fixed_length_secure_compare(a, b)
    rescue NoMethodError
      # Fallback constant-time comparison for older OpenSSL bindings
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      res = 0
      a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| res |= x ^ y }
      res.zero?
    end
  end

  class ReportGenerator
    attr_reader :user_context, :report_type

    def initialize(user_context, report_type)
      @user_context = user_context
      @report_type = report_type
    end

    def generate_export(data)
      validate_permissions!
      staging_path = prepare_staging_area
      write_report_data(staging_path, data)
      finalize_report(staging_path)
    end

    private

    def validate_permissions!
      required_role = case report_type
                      when 'summary' then :user
                      when 'detailed' then :manager
                      when 'full_audit' then :admin
                      else :admin
                      end
      user_role_level = ROLES[user_context[:role].to_sym] || 0
      required_level = ROLES[required_role] || 3
      raise "Insufficient permissions" unless user_role_level >= required_level
    end

    def prepare_staging_area
      base_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, 'staging')
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(base_dir)
      # Create staging file for report assembly
      staging_file = create_temp_staging(base_dir)
      staging_file
    end

    def create_temp_staging(base_dir)
      # Generate unique filename using timestamp and user context
      timestamp = Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
      unique_id = user_context[:uid].to_s
      filename = "report_#{timestamp}_#{unique_id}.tmp"
      filepath = File.join(base_dir, filename)
      # Set permissions before writing
      File.open(filepath, File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::TRUNC) do |f|
        f.chmod(0600)
        f.write('')
      end
      filepath
    end

    def write_report_data(path, data)
      content = format_report(data)
      File.open(path, 'w') do |f|
        f.write(content)
      end
    end

    def format_report(data)
      header = "Report Type: #{report_type}\n"
      header += "Generated: #{Time.now.iso8601}\n"
      header += "User: #{user_context[:uid]}\n"
      header += "---\n"
      header + data.to_json
    end

    def finalize_report(staging_path)
      final_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, 'reports', user_context[:uid].to_s)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(final_dir)
      final_name = "#{report_type}_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}.json"
      final_path = File.join(final_dir, final_name)
      FileUtils.mv(staging_path, final_path)
      File.chmod(0600, final_path)
      final_path
    end
  end

  class DeviceLogProcessor
    def initialize(device_id, session_token)
      @device_id = sanitize_device_id(device_id)
      @session_token = session_token
    end

    def process_crash_log(log_data)
      temp_path = buffer_log_to_disk(log_data)
      parsed = parse_log(temp_path)
      cleanup(temp_path)
      parsed
    end

    private

    def sanitize_device_id(id)
      id.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, '')[0..63]
    end

    def buffer_log_to_disk(log_data)
      # Buffer large crash logs to disk to avoid memory pressure
      tmp_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, 'tmp', 'logs')
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(tmp_dir, mode: 0700)
      # Use unpredictable path with secure random to prevent symlink attacks
      log_file = File.join(tmp_dir, "crash_#{@device_id}_#{SecureRandom.hex(16)}.log")
      File.open(log_file, File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::EXCL, 0600) do |f|
        f.write(log_data)
      end
      log_file
    end

    def parse_log(path)
      content = File.read(path)
      { lines: content.lines.count, size: content.bytesize, device: @device_id }
    end

    def cleanup(path)
      File.delete(path) if File.exist?(path)
    end
  end
end

# Sinatra API endpoints
set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
set :port, 4567

before do
  content_type :json
  @current_user = nil
  auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
  if auth_header&.start_with?('Bearer ')
    token = auth_header.sub('Bearer ', '')
    @current_user = MobileAPI::AuthToken.verify(token)
  end
end

helpers do
  def require_auth!
    halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless @current_user
  end

  def require_role(min_role)
    require_auth!
    user_level = MobileAPI::ROLES[@current_user['role'].to_sym] || 0
    required_level = MobileAPI::ROLES[min_role] || 3
    halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json unless user_level >= required_level
  end
end

post '/api/v1/reports/generate' do
  require_auth!
  body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  report_type = body['type'] || 'summary'
  data = body['data'] || {}

  generator = MobileAPI::ReportGenerator.new(
    { uid: @current_user['uid'], role: @current_user['role'] },
    report_type
  )

  begin
    path = generator.generate_export(data)
    { status: 'success', report_path: File.basename(path) }.to_json
  rescue => e
    halt 403, { error: e.message }.to_json
  end
end

post '/api/v1/devices/:device_id/crash_logs' do
  require_auth!
  device_id = params[:device_id]
  log_data = request.body.read

  processor = MobileAPI::DeviceLogProcessor.new(device_id, request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])
  result = processor.process_crash_log(log_data)
  { status: 'processed', summary: result }.to_json
end

get '/api/v1/health' do
  { status: 'ok', timestamp: Time.now.iso8601 }.to_json
end
